name: Desires From Beyond
source:
Josh (Name changeable by the player)
was away from his native home studying when he receives a message from his family to return to the city.
His family was rather disjointed, and the issue was that they needed his signature to inherit a luxury Resort from his grandfather Saul, a former member of The Eternal Sunset Society.
